field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion records expected, observed, passed, and principle.
field_principles.arc_capture_complete_score: One means all four dispositions and raw lineage are authenticated.
field_principles.arc_method_value_score: One requires useful prediction and consumed plans in both treatment games.
field_principles.claim_scope: Four episodes over two public games support a pilot case study only.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.ended_at_utc: Record the actual UTC terminal construction time.
field_principles.execution_host: Record the host separately from the execution venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify real device execution separately.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identify this invocation with an ordinary stable string.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked work name upstream, exact check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.identity_obligation_rows: Each episode proves strict runtime identity before generation.
field_principles.inference_mode: Use live_gpu only when task-owned CUDA execution is observed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation, not a task label.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare full generation, load-only work, or the actual no-model class.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.new_solve_claimed: Registered public progress is not a new solve claim.
field_principles.official_score: Keep the official score unset because no submission or upload occurs.
field_principles.per_game_results: Keep four paired-arm rows with errors, costs, censoring, and progress.
field_principles.phase_spans: Keep load, generation, benchmark, and validation spans distinct.
field_principles.policy_consumption_rows: Bind predicted transition, selected plan, and actual action issued.
field_principles.population_confidence_interval: Remain unset because this pilot has only two games.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.raw_request_manifest: Retain every actual request and response byte receipt.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: List only levels reproduced from captured live action labels.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, input manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.runner_receipt: Bind current Qwen GGUF ownership, server, model hash, raw calls, and CUDA samples.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, censored units, and the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.selection_receipt: Prove registry precheck fixed the two public development games before play.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Only live_agent_self_discovery can support this live method path.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC invocation start.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in checkpoints.
field_principles.submission_configuration_diff: Keep local and submitted runtime differences explicit.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash; do not hide failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict vocabulary; oracle authority forbids positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.
